name: EUGENE CATRAMBONE
abstract_title: DMT, Microtubule Coherence, and the Scalar Clock: A Unified Framework for Time-Consciousness
abstract: The question of why time feels the way it does remains central to both philosophy and neuroscience. Current approaches either appeal to physical time as an external background, or else reduce temporal phenomenology to neural computation. This paper develops an alternative ontological framework in which consciousness and energy are equivalent primitives (E ≡ C), and subjective time arises from their intrinsic dynamics.
